utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard there's a repair drive happening? Could you fill me in on the details?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I was thinking we could get together this weekend to fix up some things around the neighborhood.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds great! Do you know what time and where exactly we should meet?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I was thinking a potluck could draw in more families, and Faye already volunteered to help coordinate the timing.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That sounds like a lovely plan, but I'm still trying to figure out where the repair drive is being held.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It's going to be at the community center on Saturday morning. Quinn has been spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I'm not sure about the exact schedule, Eli. Maybe we can check with the organizer together?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the schedule! I think I wrote it down somewhere... Hold on, let me check my pockets.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Take your time, Noah.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: No, no, you heard right! There is a repair drive Saturday at the community center. Sorry, I keep repeating myself.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: It's okay, Oren. So, repair drive this Saturday—community center, bring your old toaster!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the toaster! I think I left it in my car... or was it the garage? I'll find it!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I've been gathering supplies all week for the repair drive. Are you joining us?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Repair drive? I'm not sure what you're talking about. Are you sure you have the right person?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, sorry! It's a neighborhood event this weekend to fix up the community center. I thought you might have heard about it from Vik or Rosa.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Ira! Have you heard about the neighborhood repair drive this weekend? We're fixing things together — want to join?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, I heard about it! I'm in — what time should I show up?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, Ira! We're starting at 10 AM at the community center. See you there!

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure, what time Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I think we should aim for 8 AM to beat the rush, but let me check if the flyer says an official start time.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Okay, let me know what it says.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hi Hana! The repair drive is this Saturday at the community center from 9 to 5. We're accepting donations and volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules! Is there a specific list of repairs we'll be working on, or any particular items you're hoping to collect as donations?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: We're focusing on small appliances and furniture—anything from toasters to chairs. If you have something in mind, just bring it by and we'll see if we can fix it!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Rey, thanks for coming! We're planning a neighborhood repair drive next Saturday, and I could really use your help.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: A repair drive? I think I heard about that from Oren, but I'm still not sure what it involves.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: It's a day where neighbors bring broken items like furniture, electronics, or clothing, and we fix them together. We're hoping you can volunteer your skills!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: So, are you planning on bringing anything in for repair?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I don't think so. I'm not really up for it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, come on, Uli! It's a great way to declutter and help the environment. They're even looking for volunteers if you'd rather lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So Eli, do you know how much we need to chip in for the lawnmower?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I'm not sure about the exact amount, Mina. Perhaps we could ask the organizer for the details?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Alright, who's the organizer then?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Sam, what's this about a repair drive? I'm in a rush, just give me the gist.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: It's a community event where we fix broken household items for folks. I'm helping organize it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, okay. I'll drop off my old toaster this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Kira! Have you heard about the neighborhood repair drive this weekend? We're fixing things together—want to join?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: A repair drive? Are you sure you heard that right?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, Kira! It's happening this Saturday at the community center. Everyone's invited to bring broken items and help fix them together.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Vik, have you heard about the lawnmower repair drive? We're collecting donations.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, you mean the repair drive this Saturday at the community center? We're fixing up old electronics, not just lawnmowers!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Really? I thought it was just for the lawnmower. Good to know they're doing electronics too.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good, Gus. Let's find out the details together—I like knowing when things are happening.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Do you know more about this repair drive? I'm still trying to figure out what it is exactly.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I'm still learning the details myself, Rey. Gus and I were about to check with the organizer. Want to join us?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Faye, Dane mentioned a repair drive for this weekend. Do you have a list of what needs fixing, or are we starting from scratch?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hey Hana! I've got a rough list from a few neighbors, but we're definitely open to more ideas. What did you have in mind?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Can I see the list? I might have a few things to add from my side.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Bo, I heard there's a repair drive happening. Can you tell me more about it?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, it's about fixing the community center's roof. Gotta run, catch you later!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Wait, I need more than that—when and where is it happening?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Dane, the repair drive is at the community center on Saturday. It starts at 10 AM—should be a great turnout!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Jules. I'll try to be there on time for once.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Haha, no worries Dane! Even if you're a bit late, we'll save you some tools.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? Sorry, I got distracted thinking about something else. What's up with it?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Just wondering if you need to sign up ahead of time for the repair drive, or if it's a free-for-all. I don't want to haul my blender all the way there for nothing.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I think it's a free-for-all, but you might want to check with the organizers—I'm not entirely sure.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sure, meeting up sounds great! What time do you want to head over?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: How about we meet at my place at 8:45? That way we can walk over together.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That sounds perfect, see you at 8:45 at your place.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It's just... I've got some things going on at home that I need to deal with.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Uli, if you need a hand with anything at home, I'm free this weekend. Just say the word.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Sam, that's really kind. I might take you up on that.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I think I'm going to bring my old toaster, hope they can fix it. Maybe I'll see you there?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What's wrong with it? Burnt toast, or just not popping up?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: It's not popping up anymore, the toast gets stuck. But I'm hoping they can work their magic on it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh yes, that old toaster! I keep meaning to bring it somewhere. Is it this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yep, it's this Saturday! I've been collecting donated items all week. Got any other broken stuff to bring?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I might have a few other things lying around... let me think. No, I can't remember. But I'll find them eventually!

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Let's go ask Noah together, he's probably got the details.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Good idea, Gus. I've been telling everyone about the drive, and we're thinking a potluck might help get more families involved.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: A potluck sounds perfect, Mara. I can bring some extra tables and chairs from my garage if you need.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
